title: Cartan-Hadamard Conjecture
exact_target: Does every smooth bounded region in a complete simply connected nonpositively curved manifold have at least the boundary measure of a Euclidean ball with the same volume?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1374 (GEOM-015). CC BY 4.0.

Benoît R. Kloeckner and Greg Kuperberg, \emph{The Cartan--Hadamard conjecture and The Little Prince} (2017), arXiv:1303.3115v3, Section 1.1, Conjecture 1.2, pp. 2--3, with curvature parameter $\kappa=0$.
